title: Style / rcParams set inside the __main__ guard before main(): native applies them, Tavotto rendered with defaults
affected_script_shapes: a script with def main() and an if __name__ == "__main__": guard that does more than call main() — plt.style.use(...), plt.rcParams[...] = ..., sns.set_theme(), np.random.seed(...) or a global assignment before (or edits after) the call
root_cause: Entry inference preferred the function entry (main > render > other zero-arg functions > __main__), and the worker calls getattr(module, entry)() on a module that is not executed as __main__, so the whole guard body was skipped and every setting made there was silently lost (cl-b941e8b82f). Fixed by #1964: discover.guard_does_more_than makes drafting, probe candidates and the registered-entry check (entryfresh) run the script as __main__ whenever the guard does anything besides one call of the entry.

repro.minimized_by: hand-written (compat_guardian.py minimize hit its 40-step budget at 7 statements; the rcParams value is put into the title so the title comparison sees it without a pixel diff)

verified.route: Safe engine path via the product discovery chain

unverified: a real user session through the UI

recurrence: 6 findings in nightly explores 11-11 to 11-14 (wrap_main + style_use / rcparams on shape_no_savefig_multi, shape_no_savefig_multi_2, shape_toplevel_imperative); every candidate whose guard setting differs from the matplotlib default
